about.metaDescription: J.S. One Sdn Bhd (200601030140/749898-T) - OpenText ECM and SAP specialists, AMS, and system development since October 2006.
about.heroSubtitle: Building Solutions that Power the Data and Technology of Tomorrow
about.overviewHeading: IT services & consulting for enterprise content
about.overviewBody1: Established October 2006, J.S. One Sdn Bhd is a Malaysia-based IT services and consulting company specializing in OpenText ECM and SAP solutions.
about.overviewBody2: As an authorized OpenText reseller and certified implementation partner, we deliver consultancy, implementation, AMS, and system development.
about.missionBody: We are constantly focusing on innovating and believe that we need to own and control the primary technologies behind the solution that we make, and participate only in markets where we can make a significant contribution.
about.visionBody: Our vision is to be Asia’s most customer centric company; to build a solution where customer value and embrace.
about.valueBody: Acknowledgement and appreciation of each customer’s individual uniqueness needs and culture.
about.whyProcessBody: Successful transformation starts with a plan. Through JS One Process Optimization services, we help customers and organizations review their current IT environment, clarify the desired transformation by recommending the required technology, people and processes.
about.whyDevBody: A positive first impression or experience is essential and plays an important role in building lasting relationship with end-users, and thus, in determining the success of any new or existing customized system.
about.whyDataBody: Fast decision-making and strategic business moves, most of the time, hinges on Big Data Analytics (BDA) tool being self-serviceable. Through the BD&A process, we bring technology and people together, working in harmony and drive your organization.
about.whyManagedBody: As the global marketplace evolves, and IT landscape becomes more complex, cost to maintain a team to manage a system or process will too become increasingly expensive. Here at JS One, we have a team of qualified support.
about.timeline2006SetupBody: JS One was set up in October 2006
about.timeline2006ProjectBody: First project completion outside of Malaysia
about.timeline2006SapAwardBody: Best SAP Technology Platform Project (Commercial Sector Category)
about.timeline2006SapCertBody: SAP granted the status of OpenText SAP Competence Partner to JS One
about.timeline2017BigDataBody: Completed Big Data Project for government agency 25TB from 36 different locations
about.timeline2018MscBody: Moved to Bangsar South Vertical Office
about.timeline2018RegionalBody: Regional expansion with offices in Singapore
about.timeline2019BwBody: First major migration and upgrade for a major O&G customer

legal.privacyMeta: How J.S. One Sdn Bhd collects, uses, and protects personal information.
legal.privacyIntro: J.S. One Sdn Bhd ("JS One", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains how we handle personal information when you use jsone.com.my or contact us.
legal.privacyCollectBody: When you submit a contact form, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, company name, and message. We also receive basic technical data such as IP address and browser type from standard server logs.
legal.privacyUseBody: We use your information to respond to enquiries, provide services, improve our website, and meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal information.
legal.privacyShareBody: We may share information with trusted processors that help us operate email delivery, hosting, or security (for example captcha providers), only as needed to provide those services.
legal.privacyRetainBody: We keep enquiry records for as long as needed to handle your request and for reasonable business or legal retention periods.
legal.privacyRightsBody: You may ask us to access, correct, or delete personal information we hold about you, subject to applicable law. Contact us at info@jsone.com.my.
legal.privacyPdpaBody: We process personal data in line with the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA) of Malaysia for the purposes described above.
legal.privacyCookiesBody: Essential cookies may be used for security (for example captcha) and basic site operation. Optional analytics tooling is not enabled until a tracking decision is confirmed.
legal.privacyContactBody: J.S. One Sdn Bhd (200601030140 (749898-T)), B-07-08 Tower B, Bangsar South, Kuala Lumpur. Email: info@jsone.com.my. Phone: +603 2242 3986.
